text:
hana: quick heads-up from int8 onboarding (pelagius-v3). small but consistent hit on samples mixing CJK + Arabic + invisible joiners. seems tied to punctuation normalization.
tom: numbers?
hana: JP->AR slice, 9.2k examples. BLEU -2.9, chrF -0.035. failures cluster on lines with mixed mid-dots, katakana dots and em-dash vs hyphen.
eli: minimal repro + token dumps:
```
Source: 東京·الأسل—テスト⁠・
FP16 tokens: ["東","\u4eac","\u00b7","\u0627...","\u2014","\u30c6","\u30b9","\u30c8","\u2060","\u30fb"]
INT8 tokens: ["東","\u4eac","\u30fb","\u0627...","-","\u30c6","\u30b9","\u30c8","-","\u30fb"]
```
so token seam shifts (middle-dot vs katakana-dot) and joiner collapse to hyphen at different boundaries. not just detok.
rui: infra note: int8 artifact used compacted vocab + new SPM packer; packer tie-break can change piece selection when invisible chars present. also different packing path can shift KV chunking and cause greedy alignment drift.
hana: hypotheses: (A) inconsistent normalizers across artifact builds (ICU vs py) + compacted vocab reordering; (B) packer tie-break + quant packing changing tokenizer binary behavior.
ci-bot: smoke-run pelagius-v3-int8 4955003399: bleu_base=22.1, bleu_int8=19.2, chrf_base=0.653, chrf_int8=0.618, regressions=471, top-pattern="middot-joiner-seam"
tom: quick mitigation: ingress canonicalizer NFKC + explicit mapping table: map U+00B7 -> U+30FB, U+2014 -> U+002D, unify U+2060->U+200D, and replace control chars with U+FFFD. add telemetry counters.
eli: add unit fixtures tests/locale/middot_joiner_cases.txt and assert token ids equal fp16 vs int8 for canonicalized inputs. add a feature flag tokenize.canonicalize_punct for canary.
rui: I'll schedule 3% canary for int8 pools tonight and collect token-dumps. if canonicalizer recovers >90% regressions we'll merge and roll. otherwise escalate to packer/serializer triage.
hana: owners: tom canonicalizer PR, eli tests + fixtures, rui canary + metrics. keeping thread here for updates. :thumbsup:
